YEAR.description: Four-digit year identifying the model version (e.g., 1970, 2008, 2020)

RULE.description:
The rule that produced the covariance. In a CCSDS covariance block,
Operator keeps the operator's COV_BASIS, ScaledFit is DETERMINED, and
SourceModel, PooledModel and EmpiricalHistoryShrunk are EMPIRICAL with
MODEL_ID as COV_BASIS_ID.

MODEL_ID.description:
Identifier of the error model (SourceModel, PooledModel) or of the
measured realism factor (ScaledFit) the covariance came from. Empty for
Operator. For EmpiricalHistoryShrunk, identifies the population prior;
EVIDENCE identifies the history estimator and its configuration.

REGIME.description: Orbit regime of the cell, as the model names it.

AGE_DAYS.description:
Age of the element set at the covariance's epoch, in days. NaN when the
covariance is not an element set's.

HORIZON_DAYS.description:
Prediction horizon of the cell, in days: the element-set age its
statistics were measured at. NaN when no cell applies.

MEASURED_LINEAGE.description:
Lineage of the reference data the cell was measured on (a PVN LINEAGE).
The test speaks for a covariance whose source has this lineage; for any
other lineage the numbers are the cell's, and CALIBRATION is Uncalibrated.

TEST_WINDOW.description:
Window of the held-out reference states the test used: an ISO 8601 UTC
interval, start/end.

MEAN_D2_OVER_3.description: Mean of d2/3 over the held-out samples. NaN when not measured.

COVERAGE_95.description:
Share of the held-out samples inside the 95 % region, 0 to 1. NaN when
not measured.

SAMPLES.description: Number of held-out samples the test used.

OBJECTS.description: Number of distinct objects the samples came from.

SCALE_FACTOR.description:
Factor the covariance was multiplied by to make it realistic. NaN when
none was applied.

CALIBRATION.description:
The verdict. Calibrated when MEAN_D2_OVER_3 lies in [0.8, 1.25] and
COVERAGE_95 in [0.93, 0.97], from at least 30 samples of at least 3
objects of MEASURED_LINEAGE; Uncalibrated otherwise, including a cell
never measured.

EVIDENCE.description: Identifier of the report or record that holds the test.

HISTORY_SAMPLES.description:
Number of retained older/newer element-set residual pairs from this
object in the age bin containing AGE_DAYS, after rejection/clipping.
Zero means no retained pairs; never the held-out test count SAMPLES.

HISTORY_SETS.description:
Number of distinct older element sets contributing HISTORY_SAMPLES.
Zero means none; never the distinct calibration-object count OBJECTS.

HISTORY_WINDOW.description:
ISO 8601 UTC start/end interval spanning the element-set epochs used
in the object's history fit. Empty when no history was used. This is
training support, not TEST_WINDOW or the element-set age AGE_DAYS.

SHRINKAGE_WEIGHT.description:
Dimensionless population-prior fraction alpha in the covariance blend
P = (1-alpha) H + alpha P_prior, where H is the history error second
moment and P_prior includes the population model's realism scaling.
Range [0,1]: 0 is all history, 1 is all prior; NaN when not applicable
or unknown. For interpolation across bins, report the correspondingly
interpolated alpha. EVIDENCE must identify the estimator/configuration,
retained-count bin, participating bins and their weights so the blend
can be reconstructed; the scalar alone does not describe that mixture.
This is not SCALE_FACTOR, which multiplies a covariance. History-only
evidence leaves CALIBRATION Uncalibrated and test statistics unmeasured.

TRUTH_EPOCHS.description:
Distinct truth epochs among the SAMPLES: predictions that share one truth
state count once here. 0 when not stated.

COVERAGE_1_SIGMA_AXIS1.description:
Share of the held-out samples whose error lies inside the 1-sigma band of
the first, second and third axis of the covariance's frame (radial,
in-track and cross-track for an RTN or curvilinear covariance), 0 to 1;
nominal 0.6827 for Gaussian errors. NaN when not measured.

COVERAGE_3_SIGMA_AXIS1.description: As COVERAGE_1_SIGMA_AXISn for the 3-sigma band; nominal 0.9973.

SOURCE_ID.description:
Publisher-stable, lowercase identifier of the source in the provider's
registry of sources.

SOURCE_KIND.description: What kind of data the source supplies.

ORIGINATOR.description:
Agency, operator or catalog that created the source data, as it names
itself. Not a message's CCSDS ORIGINATOR, which names who created the
message.

PROVIDER_ID.description:
Identifier of the provider that published the product, as the provider
names itself: the module, node or service that retrieved the source data.

PRODUCER.description:
Identifier of the software that made the product from the source data,
with its version when it has one.

LICENSE_CLASS.description: What the source's terms permit for the product.

LICENSE_ID.description:
Identifier of the terms LICENSE_CLASS was read from: an SPDX license
identifier where one applies, else the identifier of the terms in the
provider's licence register.

LINEAGE.description:
Identifier of the lineage the source's data descends from. Sources that
republish one upstream share its lineage, so their products are not
independent of each other.

SOURCE_URL.description:
Replayable URL or provider query identifying the source material as it
was retrieved (the SOURCE_URL of $CMR and $AVL).

SOURCE_VERSION.description:
Source revision, edition or upstream update marker verbatim: for a file
its originator stamps, the stamp.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond time the source material was retrieved.

SOURCE_SHA256.description:
SHA-256 of the exact source payload bytes as retrieved, 64 lowercase
hexadecimal characters. Empty when the source cannot expose replayable
bytes.

SOURCE_BYTES.description:
Number of source bytes SOURCE_SHA256 covers: the length of the prefix when
the source was fetched by range. 0 when not stated.

RFMOrigin.description:
The point a coordinate system is centred on. Body and barycentre
identifiers are integer ephemeris body codes; text NAME is descriptive
only and is never the machine key.

CELESTIAL_BODY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code when KIND is CELESTIAL_BODY.

BARYCENTRE_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the barycentre when KIND is BARYCENTRE.

LIBRATION_POINT.description: Which libration point, when KIND is LIBRATION_POINT.

LIBRATION_PRIMARY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the libration system primary.

LIBRATION_SECONDARY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the libration system secondary.

OBJECT_ID.description: Identifier of the space object when KIND is SPACE_OBJECT.

SITE_ID.description: Identifier of the surface site when KIND is GROUND_SITE.

SITE_BODY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the body the site sits on.

SITE_LATITUDE.description: Geodetic latitude of the site, degrees, positive north.

SITE_LONGITUDE.description: Geodetic longitude of the site, degrees, positive east.

SITE_ALTITUDE.description: Height of the site above the reference ellipsoid, metres.

RFMObjectReferencedAxes.description:
Axes built from the relative geometry of two objects. Exactly two of the
three axis assignments are independent; the third completes the triad.

RFMLocalAlignedConstrainedAxes.description:
Axes built by aligning one vector with a reference direction and using a
second vector as a constraint. Vectors are 3-element, expressed in the
coordinate system named by REFERENCE_COORDINATE_SYSTEM_NAME.

RFMCoordinateSystem.description:
A fully specified coordinate system: an axis set, an origin, and the epoch
and time system the axis set is evaluated at. This is the unit a frames
consumer needs; the pre-existing RFMUnion members name an axis convention
alone and cannot express an origin.

NAME.description: Stable name for this coordinate system within the producing data set.

AXIS_REFERENCE_BODY_ID.description:
Ephemeris body code whose equator/rotation defines the axes, for the
body-referenced axis types. Independent of ORIGIN.

EPOCH.description:
Reference epoch the axis set is evaluated at, ISO 8601. Required for the
of-date and of-epoch axis types; ignored by the inertial ones.

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description:
Time system the EPOCH is expressed in, named by the $TIM timingStandard
member name (for example "UTC", "TAI", "TT", "TDB", "A1").

KERNEL_FRAME_NAME.description: Kernel-declared frame name for EPHEMERIS_KERNEL_DEFINED axes.

KERNEL_FRAME_ID.description: Kernel-declared numeric frame id for EPHEMERIS_KERNEL_DEFINED axes.

EOP_DATA_SET_CID.description:
Content identifier of the Earth-orientation data set used to realise
this system, when the axis chain requires one. Recorded so that two
consumers can prove they used the same table rather than assume it.

GALCEN_RA_DEG.description:
ICRS right ascension of the Galactic center, degrees. NaN means absent.
Sgr A*: 17h45m40.0409s (Reid & Brunthaler 2004, ApJ 616, 872).

GALCEN_DEC_DEG.description:
ICRS declination of the Galactic center, degrees. NaN means absent.
Sgr A*: -29d00m28.118s (Reid & Brunthaler 2004, ApJ 616, 872).

GALCEN_DISTANCE_PC.description:
Sun-to-Galactic-center distance R0, parsecs. NaN means absent.
Example: 8178 pc (GRAVITY Collaboration 2019, A&A 625, L10).

Z_SUN_PC.description:
Solar height above the Galactic midplane, parsecs, positive north.
NaN means absent; example: 20.8 pc (Bennett & Bovy 2019, MNRAS 482, 1417).

ROLL_DEG.description:
Roll angle in degrees in the Astropy Galactocentric convention.
NaN means absent, not zero. With GALACTIC axes, the five explicit scalar
parameters define a derived Galactocentric orientation: X points from
the Sun toward the center's projection in the midplane, Y follows
Galactic rotation, and Z completes a right-handed triad toward Galactic
north. This parameterized orientation is independent of ORIGIN; with
GALACTIC_CENTER the Sun lies at X=-sqrt(R0^2-Z_SUN_PC^2), Y=0, Z=Z_SUN_PC.
All five scalars must be finite for a spatial Galactocentric transform,
with R0 > 0 and abs(Z_SUN_PC) <= R0; none has an assumed default.

V_SUN_KMS.description:
Total solar velocity [v_X,v_Y,v_Z] in km/s in the resulting Galactocentric
axes, including circular motion (not just peculiar U,V,W). Exactly three
components when present; omit the vector when unknown, or use NaN for
an unknown component. A velocity transform requires all three finite.
Schonrich, Binney & Dehnen (2010), MNRAS 403, 1829, constrain peculiar
motion; Reid & Brunthaler (2020), ApJ 892, 39, constrain Sgr A* motion.
Publishers must state their adopted total velocity; no default is implied.

TIMCcsdsTimeCode.description: CCSDS time-code payload and preamble metadata.

PREAMBLE_FIELD2.description: Second CCSDS preamble field octet; ignored when not signaled by preamble 1.

AGENCY_DEFINED_EPOCH_ISO8601.description: Optional agency-defined epoch timestamp for agency epoch time codes.

CCSDS_EPOCH_ISO8601.description: Optional CCSDS epoch override timestamp; defaults to 1958-01-01T00:00:00 TAI.

TIMInstant.description: Numeric or textual instant tagged with its time system and representation.

EPOCH_FORMAT.description: Interpretation of JULIAN_DATE, SECONDS, and ISO8601.

JULIAN_DATE.description: Julian Date or Modified Julian Date day value, selected by EPOCH_FORMAT.

SECONDS.description: Seconds for UNIX_SECONDS, GPS_SECONDS, GNSS_WEEK_SECONDS, or MISSION_ELAPSED_SECONDS.

ISO8601.description: ISO 8601 timestamp text for ISO8601 inputs or display outputs.

SUBSECOND_NANOS.description: Additional nanoseconds beyond the fractional scalar/text value.

EPOCH_LABEL.description: Optional application-defined epoch label for MET, MRT, or SCLK values.

GNSS_WEEK.description: GNSS week number when EPOCH_FORMAT is GNSS_WEEK_SECONDS.

GNSS_ROLLOVER_REFERENCE_ISO8601.description: Optional Orekit-style GNSS week rollover reference timestamp.

CCSDS_TIME_CODE.description: CCSDS time-code payload when EPOCH_FORMAT is CCSDS_TIME_CODE.

TIMConversionRequest.description: Request to convert one instant into another time system/representation.

TAI_MINUS_UTC_SECONDS.description: Optional TAI-UTC override in seconds for the source instant.

HAS_TAI_MINUS_UTC.description: Whether TAI_MINUS_UTC_SECONDS should override runtime leap-second data.

DUT1_SECONDS.description: Optional UT1-UTC override in seconds for UT1 conversions.

HAS_DUT1.description: Whether DUT1_SECONDS should override runtime Earth-orientation data.

TIMConversionResult.description: Result of a time conversion request.

DELTA_SECONDS.description: Target minus source offset in SI seconds for the requested conversion.

ERROR_MESSAGE.description: Optional error detail when STATUS is not OK.

TRACE_ID.description: Caller trace/correlation identifier copied from the request when present.

TIME_SYSTEM.description: Legacy time-system selector retained for existing TIM consumers.

FrequencyRange.description: Frequency range with lower and upper limits

StokesParameters.description: Stokes parameters, representing different aspects of polarization

U.description: Another linear polarization, orthogonal to Q

Band.description: Table representing a frequency band with a name and frequency range

DATA_MODE.description: Mode of the data (real, simulated, synthetic)

POWER_TYPE.description: Type of power (eg. AC or DC)

TRANSMIT.description: Indicates if the EMT can transmit

RECEIVE.description: Indicates if the EMT can receive

TASKABLE.description: Indicates if the site is taskable

NAME.description: Display name of the owner or source the code stands for.

DESCRIPTION.description: Longer description of the owner or source.

ACTIVE.description: True while the code is in current use by the publishing catalogue.

SOURCE_URL.description: URL of the reference table the row was retrieved from.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: ISO 8601 UTC time the reference table was retrieved.

CATProduct.description: One product the catalog selected for the object, by content identifier.

RECORD_CID.description:
CIDv1 of the product record: a multihash (SHA-256) of its exact bytes as
published, a size-prefixed FlatBuffer.

SOURCE_ID.description: The product's source: its PROVENANCE SOURCE_ID.

EPOCH.description:
Epoch of the product, ISO 8601 UTC: an $OMM's EPOCH, an $OCM's
MEAN_ELEMENTS.EPOCH or first state epoch.

SELECTION_REASON.description:
Why the catalog selected this product over the other candidates of its
KIND, as the selecting integrator states it (for example, the lowest
measured median error for the object's orbit regime and prediction
horizon).

STALE.description:
True when a maneuver after EPOCH retired the product and no product of its
KIND from after the maneuver has been selected yet.

OBJECT_TYPE.description: Object type (Payload, Rocket body, Debris, Unknown)

RCS.description: Radar Cross Section [meters2]; blank if no data available

ORBIT_TYPE.description: Orbit type (Orbit, Landing, Impact, Docked to RSO, roundtrip)

MANEUVERABLE.description: Indicates if the object is maneuverable

SIZE.description: Size [meters]; blank if no data available

MASS.description: Mass [kilograms]; blank if no data available

BUS_ID.description:
Join key to the BUS record describing this object's satellite bus; holds
that record's BUS.ID verbatim. MANUFACTURER, DIM_X/DIM_Y/DIM_Z, DRY_MASS
and WET_MASS are properties of the bus design and live on BUS — they are
NOT duplicated here. Empty when the bus is unknown.

CATALOG_URI.description:
Absolute URI identifying the original catalog's object-ID namespace.
This is an identifier, not an instruction to fetch a resource. Use with
CATALOG_OBJECT_ID only when both fields are present. Preserve the pair
through replicas and derived catalogs; it does not assert a NORAD or
COSPAR association. If the authority can reassign an object ID, this URI
must identify its immutable edition or assignment interval, rather than
the unversioned catalog. Stable IDs may use a persistent catalog URI.

CATALOG_OBJECT_ID.description:
Exact, opaque object identifier assigned by CATALOG_URI's authority.
Preserve case, Unicode and leading zeros. Numeric-looking native IDs
are not NORAD_CAT_ID values. Neither a matching name nor a native ID
in a different namespace establishes that two records describe the same
physical object. Publication provenance retains source and edition data.

PRODUCTS.description:
The products an integrating catalog selected for the object as of
PRODUCTS_AS_OF: one $OMM per mean-element theory, each with the $OCM of
the same source and epoch where there is one. The object's maneuvers are
its $MNV stream, not references here.

PRODUCTS_AS_OF.description: ISO 8601 UTC instant the selection in PRODUCTS holds at.

PPEPositionRecord.description:
A single time-segment record of polynomial coefficients for Cartesian position
(and optionally velocity). Coefficients are stored per axis.

To evaluate position at time t within this record's validity window:
1. Compute normalized time: tau = (t - EPOCH_MID) / EPOCH_HALF_SPAN
where tau is in [-1, +1].
2. Evaluate the polynomial basis of degree (NUM_COEFFICIENTS - 1) using
the coefficients for each axis.

Velocity coefficients, if present, follow the same evaluation procedure.
If HAS_VELOCITY_COEFFICIENTS is false, velocity can be obtained by
analytically differentiating the position polynomial.

EPOCH_MID.description:
Midpoint epoch of this record's validity window (ISO 8601 UTC or TDB).
Together with EPOCH_HALF_SPAN, defines the time interval:
[EPOCH_MID - EPOCH_HALF_SPAN, EPOCH_MID + EPOCH_HALF_SPAN]

EPOCH_HALF_SPAN.description:
Half-span of the validity window in seconds.
The full span is 2 * EPOCH_HALF_SPAN seconds centered on EPOCH_MID.

NUM_COEFFICIENTS.description:
Number of polynomial coefficients per axis.
The polynomial degree is (NUM_COEFFICIENTS - 1).
Typical values: 8-32 for high-fidelity ephemeris fits.

BASIS_TYPE.description: Polynomial basis type for interpreting the coefficient arrays.

POS_COEFF_X.description:
Position coefficients for X-axis (km).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS. Ordered c0, c1, ..., c_{N-1}.

POS_COEFF_Y.description:
Position coefficients for Y-axis (km).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

POS_COEFF_Z.description:
Position coefficients for Z-axis (km).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

HAS_VELOCITY_COEFFICIENTS.description:
Whether explicit velocity coefficients are provided.
If false, velocity should be derived by differentiating the position polynomial.

VEL_COEFF_X.description:
Velocity coefficients for X-axis (km/s). Optional.
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS if present.

MAX_POSITION_RESIDUAL.description: Maximum position fit residual over this segment (km). Optional quality metric.

RMS_POSITION_RESIDUAL.description: RMS position fit residual over this segment (km). Optional quality metric.

PPEOrbitalElementRecord.description:
A single time-segment record of polynomial coefficients for classical orbital elements.

The six classical elements are:
1. SMA or R_PERIAPSIS (size/shape) — see SIZE_SHAPE_TYPE
2. Eccentricity (dimensionless)
3. Inclination (degrees)
4. Right Ascension of Ascending Node / RAAN (degrees)
5. Argument of Periapsis (degrees)
6. Anomaly (degrees) — see ANOMALY_TYPE

Evaluation follows the same normalized-time procedure as PPEPositionRecord.

EPOCH_MID.description: Midpoint epoch of this record's validity window (ISO 8601 UTC or TDB).

EPOCH_HALF_SPAN.description: Half-span of the validity window in seconds.

NUM_COEFFICIENTS.description: Number of polynomial coefficients per element.

BASIS_TYPE.description: Polynomial basis type for interpreting the coefficient arrays.

SIZE_SHAPE_TYPE.description: Parameterization of the first orbital element (SMA vs R_PERIAPSIS).

ANOMALY_TYPE.description: Anomaly type for the sixth orbital element.

COEFF_SIZE_SHAPE.description:
Coefficients for SMA or radius of periapsis (km).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

COEFF_ECCENTRICITY.description:
Coefficients for eccentricity (dimensionless).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

COEFF_INCLINATION.description:
Coefficients for inclination (degrees).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

COEFF_RAAN.description:
Coefficients for RAAN (degrees).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

COEFF_ARG_PERIAPSIS.description:
Coefficients for argument of periapsis (degrees).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

COEFF_ANOMALY.description:
Coefficients for anomaly (degrees). See ANOMALY_TYPE for interpretation.
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

MAX_ELEMENT_RESIDUAL.description:
Maximum element fit residual over this segment. Optional quality metric.
Units depend on the element (km for SMA, degrees for angles, dimensionless for ecc).

RMS_ELEMENT_RESIDUAL.description: RMS element fit residual over this segment. Optional quality metric.

PPE.description:
Polynomial Ephemeris — top-level message containing metadata and
one or more polynomial coefficient records for a single space object.

A PPE message may contain position records, orbital element records, or both.
Records should be ordered chronologically by EPOCH_MID and should collectively
cover the time span [START_TIME, STOP_TIME] without gaps.

CENTER_NAME.description: Origin of the reference frame (e.g., EARTH, MOON, MARS).

TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system used for all epochs in this message.

START_TIME.description: Start of the total time span covered by this ephemeris (ISO 8601).

STOP_TIME.description: End of the total time span covered by this ephemeris (ISO 8601).

DEFAULT_BASIS_TYPE.description:
Default polynomial basis type for all records in this message.
Individual records may override this with their own BASIS_TYPE field.

POSITION_RECORDS.description:
Array of position polynomial records.
Each record covers a time segment; together they span [START_TIME, STOP_TIME].

ORBITAL_ELEMENT_RECORDS.description:
Array of orbital element polynomial records.
Each record covers a time segment; together they span [START_TIME, STOP_TIME].

EPHEMERIS_SOURCE.description:
Generating ephemeris source, verbatim as the generator names itself
(e.g., a planetary ephemeris series designation, a numerical propagator
name and version, or an in-house tool identifier).

NOMINAL_SEGMENT_SPAN.description:
Fit span in seconds used to generate each polynomial segment.
Informational; actual spans are in individual records.

NOMINAL_NUM_COEFFICIENTS.description:
Nominal number of coefficients per segment.
Informational; actual counts are in individual records.

PROVENANCE.description: Where this polynomial ephemeris comes from and the terms it travels under.

FRMStateVector.description:
A state in a named element set at a named epoch. ELEMENTS is the element
set's own 6 values in the order documented on frmStateRepresentation.
POSITION and VELOCITY are the Cartesian projection of the same state and
are populated when REPRESENTATION is CARTESIAN or when the provider can
supply them; a consumer MUST NOT infer velocity from POSITION alone.

ELEMENTS.description: The 6 element values of REPRESENTATION, SI units and radians.

COORDINATE_SYSTEM_NAME.description:
Name of the coordinate system these elements are expressed in; resolves
against RFMCoordinateSystem.NAME.

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system of EPOCH, named by the $TIM timingStandard member name.

GRAVITATIONAL_PARAMETER.description:
Gravitational parameter, m^3/s^2, of the origin body when the element
set requires one. Absent means the provider's default for the origin.

SOURCE_COORDINATE_SYSTEM.description: Coordinate system the request's state is expressed in.

TARGET_COORDINATE_SYSTEM.description: Coordinate system the result is required in.

SOURCE_STATE.description:
The full input state, carrying velocity as well as position. POSITION
above is position-only and remains the input for operations 1-4.

TARGET_REPRESENTATION.description: Element set the result must be expressed in.

EPOCH.description:
Epoch the transform is evaluated at, ISO 8601. Required for every
time-dependent axis chain.

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system of EPOCH, named by the $TIM timingStandard member name.

EOP_DATA_SET_CID.description:
Content identifier of the Earth-orientation data set the caller requires
the provider to use. A provider that cannot honour it returns
MISSING_EOP_DATA rather than substituting another table.

TARGET_STATE.description:
The transformed state, with velocity, in TARGET_COORDINATE_SYSTEM and
TARGET_REPRESENTATION.

ROTATION_DCM.description: Rotation from the source axes to the target axes at EPOCH.

ROTATION_DCM_RATE.description:
Time derivative of ROTATION_DCM, per second. Required for a velocity
transform between relatively rotating axis sets.

ANGULAR_VELOCITY_RAD_S.description:
Angular velocity of the target axes with respect to the source axes,
radians per second, expressed in the source axes.

EOP_DATA_SET_EPOCH.description: Epoch of the Earth-orientation data set actually used, ISO 8601.

EOP_DATA_SET_CID.description: Content identifier of the Earth-orientation data set actually used.

PCEParameterRef.description:
A reference to one parameter, with the dependencies that make it evaluable.
This is what a request, a stopping condition and a report column all name.

PROVIDER_DEFINED_NAME.description: REQUIRED when PARAMETER is PROVIDER_DEFINED, absent otherwise.

ELEMENT_INDEX.description:
Component of a vector or matrix parameter, zero-based and row-major.
Negative selects the whole value.

COORDINATE_SYSTEM_NAME.description:
Coordinate system this evaluation is expressed in; resolves against
RFMCoordinateSystem.NAME in PCEEvaluationContext.COORDINATE_SYSTEMS.
Absent means the context default.

CENTRAL_BODY_ID.description:
Ephemeris body code of the central body, when the parameter is
CENTRAL_BODY_DEPENDENT and the context default is not wanted.

SITE_ID.description: Site the parameter is evaluated from, when it is SURFACE_SITE_DEPENDENT.

SECOND_OBJECT_ID.description: Second object, when the parameter is SECOND_OBJECT_DEPENDENT.

OWNER_OBJECT_ID.description: Owning object, when the request evaluates more than one.

OWNER_HARDWARE_NAME.description:
Owning hardware item, when the owner class is THRUSTER, FUEL_TANK or a
burn.

TIME_SYSTEM.description:
Time system for an EPOCH-typed parameter, named by the $TIM
timingStandard member name. Absent means the context default.

PCEParameterDescriptor.description:
One roster entry as a named publisher implements it. The catalog is the
authority a consumer resolves a name through BEFORE it asks for a value.

PROVIDER_DEFINED_NAME.description: REQUIRED when PARAMETER is PROVIDER_DEFINED, absent otherwise.

PROVIDER_DEFINED_UNIT_SYMBOL.description: REQUIRED when UNIT is PROVIDER_DEFINED, absent otherwise.

ELEMENT_COUNT.description:
Number of values for REAL_VECTOR, and rows times columns for
REAL_MATRIX. Absent or 1 for a scalar.

ROW_COUNT.description: Matrix shape, REQUIRED when DATA_TYPE is REAL_MATRIX.

REQUIRED_AXIS_TYPE.description:
The one axis set this parameter is defined for, when it is defined for
only one: planetodetic quantities require BODY_FIXED. UNSPECIFIED means
any axis set the request names.

REQUIRED_ORIGIN_KIND.description:
The one origin kind this parameter is defined for, when it is defined
for only one. UNSPECIFIED means any origin the request names.

TIME_SYSTEM_DEPENDENT.description:
The value changes with the time system it is asked for, independently of
the frame.

STATE_REPRESENTATION.description:
The element set this parameter is a member of, when it is a member of
one; UNSPECIFIED for a derived scalar that belongs to no set.

UNAVAILABLE_REASON.description:
REQUIRED when AVAILABILITY is DECLARED_UNAVAILABLE: what is missing,
stated as a capability, so a consumer can report the refusal.

SUPERSEDED_BY.description: REQUIRED when AVAILABILITY is DEPRECATED: the parameter to migrate to.

SUPPORTS_STOPPING_CONDITION.description:
The publisher can bracket and refine a root of this parameter, so it may
be used as a stopping condition or a generic event function. A parameter
that is not continuous in time MUST declare false.

IS_SETTABLE.description:
The parameter can be written as well as read, so it may be a targeting
variable.

IS_CYCLIC.description: The value wraps: a goal crossing must be tested modulo the cycle.

CYCLE_LOWER_BOUND.description:
Inclusive lower and exclusive upper bound of the cycle, REQUIRED when
IS_CYCLIC is true.

DESCRIPTION.description: One sentence, capability language, no product or organization names.

PCEParameterCatalog.description:
The roster a named publisher offers, resolved as a whole. A consumer
caches this and resolves every later name against it.

PROVIDER_ID.description: Identifier of the publisher that evaluates these parameters.

PUBLISHED_AT.description: ISO 8601 instant this catalog was published.

PCEEvaluationContext.description: Everything an evaluation needs besides the state itself.

OBJECT_ID.description: Identifier of the object the parameters are evaluated on.

HARDWARE_NAME.description: Hardware item, when the owner class names one.

CENTRAL_BODY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the default central body.

GRAVITATIONAL_PARAMETER.description:
Gravitational parameter of the central body, m^3/s^2. Absent means the
provider's own value for CENTRAL_BODY_ID.

EQUATORIAL_RADIUS_M.description: Shape of the central body, REQUIRED for planetodetic parameters.

COORDINATE_SYSTEMS.description:
Fully specified coordinate systems, each named through
RFMCoordinateSystem.NAME.

DEFAULT_COORDINATE_SYSTEM_NAME.description: Which of COORDINATE_SYSTEMS a parameter reference falls back to.

DEFAULT_TIME_SYSTEM.description:
Time system a parameter reference falls back to, named by the $TIM
timingStandard member name.

REFERENCE_EPOCH.description: Zero of ELAPSED_DAYS and ELAPSED_SECONDS, ISO 8601.

EOP_DATA_SET_CID.description:
Content identifier of the Earth-orientation data set the caller requires.
A provider that cannot honour it returns MISSING_EOP_DATA rather than
substituting another table.

ILLUMINATING_BODY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the illuminating body for lighting parameters.

PCEEvaluationRequest.description:
Evaluate these parameters on these states. One state is a point query; a
run of states is a report or a plot series, and carries the same shape.

STATES.description:
States to evaluate at, in chronological order. Each carries its own
epoch and coordinate system name.

PCEParameterValue.description:
One parameter's value at one state. STATUS is per value: a request never
fails as a whole because one name is unavailable.

VALUE.description: Scalar, integer or boolean value. Absent for vector and matrix types.

VALUES.description:
Vector or matrix values, row-major. Absent for scalar types; a scalar is
NEVER also written here.

ROW_COUNT.description: Matrix shape, REQUIRED when the descriptor's DATA_TYPE is REAL_MATRIX.

UNIT.description:
Unit the value is expressed in, restating the descriptor so a value is
self-describing when it travels without its catalog.

MESSAGE.description: Why STATUS is not OK, in capability language.

PCEParameterSample.description: The evaluated parameters at ONE epoch.

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system of EPOCH, named by the $TIM timingStandard member name.

SAMPLES.description: One sample per requested state, in the requested order.

EOP_DATA_SET_CID.description: Content identifier of the Earth-orientation data set actually used.

PCEParameterCondition.description:
A predicate on a named parameter: the parameter attains GOAL_VALUE, in
DIRECTION, for the OCCURRENCE-th time. This is the ONE spelling of a
stopping condition and of a generic event function; $EVL references it
rather than minting a second one.

GOAL_VALUE.description: Value the parameter must attain, in the parameter's own SI unit.

GOAL_TOLERANCE.description:
Convergence bar on the parameter value at the reported epoch, in the
parameter's own unit. A provider that cannot meet it returns
ROOT_REFINEMENT_FAILED rather than reporting an unconverged root.

OCCURRENCE.description:
Which attainment satisfies the condition, one-based. 0 and 1 both mean
the first.

PCEStopRequest.description:
Propagate until a condition is attained. The propagator itself is NOT named
here: it is a port the caller supplies, per the pluggable-propagation law.
This record carries only the condition, the interval and the tolerances.

CONDITIONS.description:
Conditions evaluated together; the run stops at whichever is attained
first in time.

MAXIMUM_ELAPSED_SECONDS.description:
Upper bound on the propagated interval. Reaching it without attaining a
condition is GOAL_NOT_ATTAINED, never a silent stop.

EPOCH_TOLERANCE_SECONDS.description:
Convergence bar on the stop epoch. The same scenario run at different
step sizes MUST land inside this bar.

SYNCHRONIZED_OBJECT_IDS.description:
Objects propagated in step with the owner and reported at the same stop
epoch.

REPORT_PARAMETERS.description: Parameters to evaluate at the stop epoch, beyond the condition itself.

PCEStopReport.description: Where a propagate-to-condition run actually landed.

ATTAINED_CONDITION_INDEX.description:
Index into PCEStopRequest.CONDITIONS of the condition that stopped the
run; negative when none did.

EPOCH.description: Epoch the run stopped at, ISO 8601.

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system of EPOCH, named by the $TIM timingStandard member name.

ELAPSED_SECONDS.description:
Seconds of propagated time from the initial state to EPOCH; negative for
a BACKWARD run.

ACHIEVED_VALUE.description: Value the condition parameter actually had at EPOCH.

GOAL_RESIDUAL.description:
ACHIEVED_VALUE minus GOAL_VALUE, in the parameter's own unit. This is
the residual a consumer gates on; it is NOT assumed to be zero.

SYNCHRONIZED_STATES.description: States of SYNCHRONIZED_OBJECT_IDS at the same epoch, in that order.

SAMPLE.description: Parameters evaluated at the stop epoch.

FUNCTION_EVALUATION_COUNT.description: Root-refinement work actually done, for the step-independence evidence.

PCE.description:
Parameter Catalog and Evaluation

The named calculation parameters an analysis resolves through: their owner
class, unit, data type, frame dependency and per-publisher availability
(CATALOG), a request and result for evaluating named parameters on states
at epochs in a stated coordinate system (EVALUATION_REQUEST /
EVALUATION_RESULT), and propagate-to-condition, which is a predicate on one
of those same names rather than a vocabulary of its own (STOP_REQUEST /
STOP_REPORT). Stopping conditions, targeting goals, report columns and plot
series all resolve names here, so a name means one thing everywhere.

Angles are radians, lengths metres, durations seconds, masses kilograms.
A buffer carries the members its exchange needs; a catalog publication and
an evaluation exchange are both complete $PCE records.

OCCULTING_BODY_IDS.description:
Ephemeris body codes of the bodies allowed to occult, in the order they
are tested. More than one is normal.

ILLUMINATING_BODY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the illuminating body.

REPORT_UMBRA.description:
Which shadow regions to report. A model that cannot distinguish a region
MUST refuse the request rather than fold it into a neighbour.

MINIMUM_DURATION_SECONDS.description: Events shorter than this are not reported. 0 reports every event.

ABERRATION_CORRECTION.description: Correct the illuminating-body direction for signal travel time.

OBSERVER.description: The observing point, normally a GROUND_SITE origin.

SENSOR_ID.description:
Identifier of the observing site or sensor; resolves against $SEN.ID
when the observer is an instrumented site.

MINIMUM_ELEVATION_RAD.description: Elevation the target must exceed, radians, when no mask is supplied.

AZIMUTH_ELEVATION_MASK_RAD.description:
Horizon mask as azimuth and minimum-elevation pairs, radians, in
ascending azimuth: [az0, el0, az1, el1, ...]. Present, it supersedes
MINIMUM_ELEVATION_RAD. An odd length is INVALID_INPUT.

OCCULTING_BODY_IDS.description: Bodies allowed to block the line of sight.

MINIMUM_DURATION_SECONDS.description: Events shorter than this are not reported.

SENSOR_ID.description:
Identifier of the sensor whose field of view is tested; resolves against
$SEN.ID. The sensor's site data is NOT restated here.

BORESIGHT_COORDINATE_SYSTEM_NAME.description:
Coordinate system BORESIGHT is expressed in; resolves against
RFMCoordinateSystem.NAME on the request context.

CONE_HALF_ANGLE_RAD.description: Half-angle of a CONIC field of view, radians.

RECTANGULAR_HALF_ANGLE_X_RAD.description: Half-angles of a RECTANGULAR field of view about the boresight, radians.

CUSTOM_MASK_RAD.description:
Boundary of a CUSTOM_MASK field of view as clock and cone angle pairs
about the boresight, radians: [clock0, cone0, clock1, cone1, ...]. An
odd length is INVALID_INPUT.

INTRUDING_BODY_IDS.description: Ephemeris body codes of the bodies tested for intrusion.

INTRUDING_OBJECT_IDS.description: Identifiers of the tracked objects tested for intrusion.

USE_APPARENT_BODY_RADIUS.description:
Test the intruder's apparent disc rather than its centre, so an event
begins when the limb enters the field of view.

CENTRAL_BODY_ID.description:
Ephemeris body code the radius is measured from. The apsis is the root
of the RADIAL_VELOCITY parameter about this body, NOT an extremum of
geodetic height; the two differ by tens of degrees of true anomaly on an
oblate body.

REFERENCE_COORDINATE_SYSTEM_NAME.description:
Coordinate system whose reference plane defines the node line; resolves
against RFMCoordinateSystem.NAME on the request context.

PLANE_NORMAL.description:
Normal of the plane crossed, in the axes of REFERENCE_COORDINATE_SYSTEM_NAME;
it need not be a unit vector. Absent or zero: the pole of those axes, which
makes the crossings the nodes of its equator. Any other normal is an
arbitrary plane through the center of the system.

CENTRAL_BODY_ID.description:
Ephemeris body code the latitude is measured about; the pole is that of
the request context's axes.

EVLParameterConditionConfiguration.description: Configuration for PARAMETER_CONDITION, the generic locator.

CONDITIONS.description:
Conditions on $PCE catalog parameters. The predicate vocabulary is
PCEParameterCondition and is NOT restated here.

REPORT_AS_INTERVAL.description:
True reports the interval BETWEEN a satisfying crossing and the next
unsatisfying one; false reports each crossing as an instantaneous event
with equal start and stop epochs.

EVLEventSample.description: Parameter values captured at one instant inside an event.

EVLEvent.description:
One located event. An instantaneous event has STOP_EPOCH equal to
START_EPOCH and DURATION_SECONDS equal to 0.

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system of the epochs, named by the $TIM timingStandard member name.

DURATION_SECONDS.description:
STOP_EPOCH minus START_EPOCH in seconds. Carried because it is the
reported quantity of an event report and MUST agree with the epochs.

TARGET_OBJECT_ID.description: The object the event happened to.

OCCULTING_BODY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the body that occulted or intruded, when one did.

OBSERVER_ID.description: Identifier of the observing site or sensor, when the class has one.

OBSERVED_OBJECT_ID.description: Identifier of the observed body or object, when the class has one.

EXTREMUM_EPOCH.description:
Epoch of the event's extremum, ISO 8601: deepest obscuration, peak
elevation, closest approach. Absent when the class has no extremum.

EXTREMUM_VALUE.description: Value at EXTREMUM_EPOCH, in the unit of EXTREMUM_PARAMETER.

EXTREMUM_PARAMETER.description: Which catalog parameter EXTREMUM_VALUE is a value of.

CONDITION_INDEX.description:
Index into EVLEventLocationRequest.PARAMETER_CONDITION_CONFIGURATION's
CONDITIONS for a generic event; negative for every other class.

SAMPLES.description: Requested parameters, evaluated at the instants of this event.

EVLEventLocationRequest.description: Locate events of one class over one interval.

TARGET_OBJECT_ID.description: Object the events are located for.

CONTEXT.description:
Bodies, coordinate systems, epoch reference and Earth-orientation data
set the geometry is evaluated in. The state source itself is a port the
caller supplies and is NOT named here.

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description:
Time system of the interval, named by the $TIM timingStandard member
name.

SCAN_STEP_SECONDS.description:
Coarse step the event function is sampled at before refinement. A
provider MAY choose its own step when this is absent, and the located
epochs MUST NOT depend on it beyond REFINEMENT_TOLERANCE_SECONDS.

REFINEMENT_TOLERANCE_SECONDS.description:
Convergence bar on a located epoch. A provider that cannot meet it
returns ROOT_REFINEMENT_FAILED.

MAXIMUM_EVENTS.description: Upper bound on reported events. 0 means no bound.

REPORT_PARAMETERS.description: Parameters to evaluate at each event's instants.

ECLIPSE_CONFIGURATION.description:
Exactly the configuration matching LOCATOR_CLASS is present; any other
combination is MISSING_CONFIGURATION.

EVLEventReport.description: The events found, and the interval they were actually searched over.

SCAN_START_EPOCH.description:
Interval actually searched, ISO 8601. A BUDGET_EXCEEDED run reports the
interval it reached, not the interval it was asked for.

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system of the epochs, named by the $TIM timingStandard member name.

EVENTS.description: Events in chronological order of START_EPOCH.

FUNCTION_EVALUATION_COUNT.description:
Event-function evaluations actually performed, for step-independence
evidence.

EOP_DATA_SET_CID.description: Content identifier of the Earth-orientation data set actually used.

EVL.description:
Event Locator

One request and one report for every class of located event: shadow
passage, site visibility, sensor-field-of-view intrusion, apsis passage,
node crossing, and the generic condition on any $PCE catalog parameter.
Every class is the same pair of an event function and a refined root, so a
new class is a configuration table and a vocabulary member, never a new
record. Entry and exit epochs, duration, the occulting or observed body and
the parameter values captured at each event's instants are reported in one
shape, and the predicate of the generic class is $PCE's
PCEParameterCondition rather than a second spelling of the same idea.

Angles are radians, durations seconds, epochs ISO 8601 in a named time
system.

PCFGaussianPrior.description:
A Gaussian prior on a fitted parameter. A prior with HAS_SIGMA false keeps
the theory's own sigma and moves only the mean.

MEAN.description: Prior mean, in the unit of the parameter it is attached to. Default 0.

SIGMA.description: Prior standard deviation, in the same unit; > 0 when HAS_SIGMA.

HAS_SIGMA.description: True when SIGMA carries a value; false keeps the theory's own sigma.

PCFFitPolicy.description:
Fit policy: how long an arc a fit uses, how that is validated, and what a
fit refuses.

DEFAULT_SPAN_HOURS.description: Fit span used when the span rule is not run, hours. Default 48.

MINIMUM_SPAN_HOURS.description: Shortest span a fit may take, hours. Default 24.

MAXIMUM_SPAN_HOURS.description: Longest span a fit may take, hours. Default 120.

CANDIDATE_SPANS_HOURS.description:
Spans the extension rule scores, ascending, hours, each within
[MINIMUM_SPAN_HOURS, MAXIMUM_SPAN_HOURS]. Empty: 48, 72 and 120; with
24 in front when the eccentricity exceeds ECCENTRICITY_THRESHOLD.

TAIL_HOURS.description:
Validation tail: each candidate is fitted to the data before the latest
TAIL_HOURS and scored on that tail, hours. Default 24.

EXTENSION_MARGIN.description:
Extension rule: a longer candidate is taken only when its tail error is
at most this fraction of the best shorter candidate's. Default 0.9.

HOLDOUT_HOURS.description:
Hours held out at the end of the data and reported as error growth; the
fit then ends HOLDOUT_HOURS before the data does. Absent, the data
block's own useable stop time decides.

HAS_HOLDOUT_HOURS.description: True when HOLDOUT_HOURS carries a value; false means absent.

ECCENTRICITY_THRESHOLD.description: Eccentricity above which the eccentric-orbit rule applies. Default 0.5.

ECCENTRIC_DEFAULT_SPAN_HOURS.description: Eccentric orbits: the default span, hours. Default 24.

ECCENTRIC_MAXIMUM_PERIOD_HOURS.description:
Eccentric orbits: no candidate longer than this is tried once the orbital
period passes it, hours. Default 36.

IMPLAUSIBLE_RMS_KM.description:
A fit whose RMS passes this is refused as fit-implausible, km. Default
100.

DRAG_PRIOR.description:
Prior on B_eff, the signed drag area-to-mass ratio Cd*A/m, m2/kg. Absent
or without sigma: mean 0, sigma 0.05.

SRP_PRIOR.description:
Prior on AGOM, the radiation-pressure area-to-mass ratio Cr*A/m, m2/kg.
Absent or without sigma: mean 0, sigma 0.05.

DRAG_PRIOR_FORM.description:
The form of DRAG_PRIOR. Default GAUSSIAN_SIGNED. LOG_NORMAL: the fit
estimates ln B_eff, so B_eff is never <= 0; DRAG_PRIOR is required, its
MEAN the median of B_eff (> 0, m2/kg) and its SIGMA the standard deviation
of ln B_eff.

SRP_PRIOR_FORM.description:
The form of SRP_PRIOR. Default GAUSSIAN_SIGNED. LOG_NORMAL: the fit
estimates ln AGOM, so AGOM is never <= 0; SRP_PRIOR is required, its MEAN
the median of AGOM (> 0, m2/kg) and its SIGMA the standard deviation of
ln AGOM.

WEATHER_HORIZON_DAYS.description:
Days past the element set's epoch day through which the fit writes the
daily space weather into the record it emits (OCM
PERTURBATIONS.SPACE_WEATHER), when the forces it fits under read rows
(WEATHER_SOURCE RECORDS). The last day written is the later of the fit
arc's last day and the epoch's day plus this count; rows supplied with
the request must reach it, or the fit is refused by name. Default 30.

PCFExpressionTerm.description: One term of an expression program.

OPERATION.description: What the term does. Default UNSPECIFIED (refused).

VALUE.description: The constant pushed by CONSTANT. Default 0.

PARAMETER.description: The catalog parameter pushed by PARAMETER. Default UNSPECIFIED.

PCFExpression.description:
A reverse Polish program of at most 64 terms and stack depth 16 that leaves one
number.

TERMS.description: The terms, in evaluation order. Default empty.

PCFEventDefinition.description:
One event to locate inside the integration. A $PCF carries the list; a $PRW
execution request carries the same definitions beside the integrator settings,
and a located event comes back as a PRWEventRecord.

DIRECTION.description: Which zero crossings of the event function count. Default ANY.

ACTION.description: What the integrator does at the event. Default RECORD.

TOLERANCE_SECONDS.description: Tolerance on the located epoch, seconds; 0 also selects 1e-9. Default 1e-9.

OCCURRENCE.description: STOP acts at this qualifying crossing (1 is the first). Default 1.

ANGLE_RAD.description: TRUE_ANOMALY and ARGUMENT_OF_LATITUDE: the angle, radians. Default 0.

PLANE_NORMAL.description:
PLANE_CROSSING: the normal, in the request's axes; it need not be a unit
vector. Default absent (the pole of the axes).

SECOND_TRAJECTORY_PORT.description:
CLOSEST_APPROACH: the id of the input port that carries the second trajectory
as $OEM; "second_trajectory" is the port FFM declares. Default empty.

PCFOutput.description: Output states: frame, step and size.

FRAME.description:
Frame of the output states. Default UNSPECIFIED (the grid template's
frame, TEME without one).

STEP_SECONDS.description:
Spacing of the output states, seconds, when no grid template names the
epochs; a grid template's epochs win. Default 60.

MAXIMUM_STATES.description: Most states one request may produce. Default 500000.

EPOCHS.description:
Output epochs, ISO 8601 UTC, ascending; when present they are the
states written and START_TIME, STOP_TIME and STEP_SECONDS are not read.
Default empty.

START_TIME.description:
First output epoch, ISO 8601 UTC. Default empty: the element set's
epoch.

STOP_TIME.description:
Last output epoch, ISO 8601 UTC, at or after START_TIME. Default empty:
START_TIME plus one day.

PCFSpaceWeather.description:
Instantaneous space weather, held for an arc when WEATHER_SOURCE selects it.
The TIM epoch is UTC; flux is in SFU (1e-22 W/m2/Hz).

EPOCH.description: Epoch the values apply to. Required; no default.

F107.description: Daily F10.7 solar radio flux, SFU. Default 150.

F107_AVERAGE.description: Centered 81-day average of F10.7, SFU. Default 150.

AP_INDEX.description:
Conventional daily Ap index value, dimensionless (not an acceleration).
Default 15.

KP_INDEX.description:
Conventional three-hour Kp index value, dimensionless (not an
acceleration). Default 3.

PCFEcom2.description:
ECOM2 empirical solar radiation pressure (Arnold et al. 2015, J. Geod. 89,
doi:10.1007/s00190-015-0814-4, eq. 5), in the D-Y-B frame, added to the a
priori model and scaled by the visible Sun fraction. Every coefficient is in
m/s^2 and defaults to 0.

PCFIntegratorSettings.description:
Integrator and its settings, shared by $PCF and $PRW. Units are SI. A scalar
legacy tolerance must be expanded by the adapter.

INITIAL_STEP_SECONDS.description: First step, seconds; the fixed step of RK4. Default 60.

MINIMUM_STEP_SECONDS.description: Smallest step an adaptive algorithm may take, seconds. Default 1.

ABSOLUTE_TOLERANCES.description:
Six or seven positive tolerances, respectively m, m/s and optional kg.
Required; no default.

MAXIMUM_STEPS.description: Most steps one propagation may take. Default 100000.

PCFForceModel.description:
The forces a propagator applies, shared by $PCF and $PRW. Flags default to
off unless stated: a force is active only when selected. No implied support
for coefficients, drag models or bodies the provider cannot supply; a
provider refuses what it cannot apply, by name.

GRAVITY_CHOICE.description: Gravity field. Default INFER_FLAGS (the ENABLE_ flags decide).

GRAVITATIONAL_PARAMETER.description:
Gravitational parameter of the central body, m3/s2; required positive
when a central gravity term is enabled. Default 0.

ENABLE_HIGHER_ZONALS.description: Zonal terms above J4. Default false.

MAXIMUM_DEGREE.description:
Highest field degree; dimensionless. Absent selects the explicitly
reported model default.

HAS_MAXIMUM_DEGREE.description: True when MAXIMUM_DEGREE carries a value; false (the default) means absent.

MAXIMUM_ORDER.description:
Highest field order; dimensionless. Absent selects the explicitly
reported model default.

HAS_MAXIMUM_ORDER.description: True when MAXIMUM_ORDER carries a value; false (the default) means absent.

ENABLE_THIRD_BODY.description: Third-body gravity of THIRD_BODY_IDS. Default false.

THIRD_BODY_IDS.description:
NAIF IDs; explicit vector, e.g. [10,301]. Empty (the default) means no
third bodies.

WEATHER.description:
Space weather held for the arc when WEATHER_SOURCE selects it. Default
absent.

EPHEMERIS_SOURCE.description:
Actual configured source name, e.g. an analytic series or a planetary SPK
kernel. Required; no default.

SOLID_TIDES.description:
Solid Earth tides. Their field is Earth-fixed, so a provider needs Earth
orientation (the request's Earth orientation rows) to apply them. Default
NONE.

IN_TRACK_ACCELERATION_M_S2.description:
Constant acceleration along the in-track axis, m/s2: T of RTN,
N cross rhat with N = unit(r cross v) (the "in-track thrust" of a VCM).
Default absent.

HAS_IN_TRACK_ACCELERATION_M_S2.description:
True when IN_TRACK_ACCELERATION_M_S2 carries a value; false (the default)
means absent.

DRAG_AREA_OVER_MASS_RATE_M2_KG_S.description:
Rate of change of the drag ballistic coefficient Cd*A/m, m2/kg/s (the
BDOT of a VCM). Drag uses Cd*A/m + rate * (t - initial epoch). Default
absent.

HAS_DRAG_AREA_OVER_MASS_RATE_M2_KG_S.description:
True when DRAG_AREA_OVER_MASS_RATE_M2_KG_S carries a value; false (the
default) means absent.

MAXIMUM_TESSERAL_DEGREE.description:
Highest degree of the tesseral and sectorial terms (order >= 1); the
zonals run to MAXIMUM_DEGREE. A VCM's "mmZ,nnT" is MAXIMUM_DEGREE mm,
MAXIMUM_ORDER nn and MAXIMUM_TESSERAL_DEGREE nn. Default absent.

HAS_MAXIMUM_TESSERAL_DEGREE.description:
True when MAXIMUM_TESSERAL_DEGREE carries a value; false (the default)
means absent.

RADIATION_PRESSURE_MODEL.description: Solar radiation pressure model family. Default CANNONBALL.

GNSS_BLOCK.description:
Spacecraft block; required when RADIATION_PRESSURE_MODEL is GNSS_BOX_WING.
Default UNSPECIFIED.

ECOM2.description: ECOM2 coefficients; absent (the default) means no ECOM2 term.

EARTH_RADIATION.description:
Earth radiation pressure (albedo and infrared). It reads the Sun's
position from the ephemeris source. Default NONE.

EARTH_RADIATION_RESOLUTION_DEG.description: Angular size of the Earth surface elements it sums, degrees. Default 15.

EARTH_RADIATION_AREA_OVER_MASS_M2_KG.description:
Isotropic Cr*A/m, m2/kg, the Earth's radiation acts on. Absent, it is the
cannonball's REFLECTIVITY_COEFFICIENT * AREA_M2 / INITIAL_MASS_KG, and
fitting SRP_AREA_OVER_MASS scales both.

HAS_EARTH_RADIATION_AREA_OVER_MASS_M2_KG.description:
True when EARTH_RADIATION_AREA_OVER_MASS_M2_KG carries a value; false (the
default) means absent.

OCEAN_TIDES.description:
Ocean tides. Their field is Earth-fixed, so a provider needs Earth
orientation (the request's Earth orientation rows) to apply them. Default
NONE.

OCEAN_TIDE_MAXIMUM_DEGREE.description: Truncation of the ocean tide field, degree. Default 30.

OCEAN_TIDE_MAXIMUM_ORDER.description: Truncation of the ocean tide field, order. Default 30.

CENTRAL_BODY_NAIF_ID.description:
Central body, a NAIF ID. The gravity field, atmosphere, tides and third
bodies are those of this body. Default 399 (Earth).

EPHEMERIS_KIND.description:
Where the Sun, Moon and planets are read from. Default UNSPECIFIED (the
source named in EPHEMERIS_SOURCE).

SHADOW_MODEL.description:
Shadow model of the radiation-pressure and Earth-radiation terms. Default
UNSPECIFIED (the provider's: conical).

WEATHER_SOURCE.description: Where the space weather comes from. Default UNSPECIFIED (inferred).

WEATHER_EXTENSION.description:
What happens past the last space weather row. Default UNSPECIFIED (the
provider's rule).

DENSITY_CORRECTION.description: Correction applied to the atmosphere model's density. Default NONE.

DENSITY_CORRECTION_RELAXATION_HOURS.description:
Past the last density-correction node the log-density scale relaxes to
its trailing mean with this time constant, hours; 0 holds the last node.
Absent, the provider's rule (the numerical propagator holds; the advanced
mean-element propagator relaxes with 48 h).

HAS_DENSITY_CORRECTION_RELAXATION_HOURS.description:
True when DENSITY_CORRECTION_RELAXATION_HOURS carries a value; false (the
default) means absent.

NEUTRAL_WIND.description: Neutral wind in the drag relative velocity. Default NONE.

THIRD_BODY_MAXIMUM_DEGREE.description:
Highest degree of the harmonic field of the third body that has one (the
Moon's on an Earth orbiter, the Earth's on a lunar orbiter); dimensionless.
The field's acceleration at the frame origin is subtracted. Default 0:
third bodies are point masses only.

THIRD_BODY_MAXIMUM_ORDER.description: Highest order of that field; dimensionless. Default 0.

PCFEpochStore.description:
The multi-epoch element store of SDN-AP and the sync harness that fills it:
how many days of element sets are kept, which set answers a request time and
how consecutive sets are blended across a handover. Absent: every default below.

CACHE_DAYS.description: Days of element sets kept, counted back from now by epoch. Default 7.

MAX_SETS_PER_OBJECT.description:
Most sets kept per object and theory, the oldest epochs dropping first.
Default 0 (no cap beyond CACHE_DAYS).

SELECTION.description: Which set answers a request time. Default NEAREST.

BLEND_WINDOW_SECONDS.description:
Width, seconds, of the blend window centered on the midpoint between two
consecutive sets; 0 switches sets without a blend. Default 3600.

BLEND_SHAPE.description: The weight curve across the blend window. Default SMOOTHSTEP.

THEORIES.description: Theories whose sets are stored (SGP4, SGP4XP). Default empty: all.

PCF.description:
Propagation Configuration ($PCF 1.0): one FlatBuffer message that configures
any propagator (SGP4, SGP4-XP, the full force model, Kepler): the theory,
the integrator and its settings, the forces, the fit policy, the events to
locate, the epoch store and the output. A host passes it beside the
request; the method it invokes selects the tables that method reads. An
absent table takes the theory's own defaults; a table or value the
selected theory cannot honor is
refused by name, never silently dropped. $PRW reuses PCFIntegratorSettings,
PCFForceModel and their enums, so the runtime wire and the configuration
share one definition of each. Units are in the field names and docs; every
field states its default.

CONFIGURATION_ID.description: Opaque identifier of this configuration, for provenance. Default empty.

PROFILE.description:
Named profile this configuration instantiates, for example "FFM-1".
Informational: every value that matters is carried below. Default empty.

THEORY.description: The orbit theory. Default UNSPECIFIED (the receiving module's own).

INTEGRATOR.description: Integrator and settings. Absent: the theory's own.

FORCES.description: Forces. Absent: the theory's built-in set.

EVENTS.description: Events located while integrating. Default empty.

EPOCH_STORE.description: The multi-epoch element store and its sync harness. Absent: the defaults of PCFEpochStore.

NCDSegmentDescriptor.description:
One independently addressed segment inside a native container.

A segmented binary ephemeris is not a single span: each segment has its own
body pair, frame, numeric type and time bounds, and a reader must choose
among them. $OEM carries the STATES; this carries the segment DESCRIPTOR
that says which states came from where and what must be written back.

NAME.description: Segment name as recorded in the container.

TARGET_NAIF_ID.description: Integer body code of the segment target.

CENTER_NAIF_ID.description: Integer body code of the segment centre.

FRAME_NAIF_ID.description: Integer reference frame code of the segment.

FRAME_NAME.description: Reference frame name as recorded in the container.

SEGMENT_TYPE.description:
Numeric segment data type, verbatim. The evaluation rule is a property of
this number (for example, Chebyshev position with fixed interval, or
discrete states with Lagrange interpolation); it is carried as the
container's own integer so a rewrite is exact.

START_SECONDS_PAST_J2000_TDB.description:
Segment coverage start, seconds past J2000 in the barycentric dynamical
time scale, as stored in the container.

INITIAL_ADDRESS.description: First addressed element of the segment inside the file.

FINAL_ADDRESS.description: Last addressed element of the segment inside the file.

POLYNOMIAL_DEGREE.description:
Polynomial degree or record size the segment type parameterises, when the
type carries one.

NCDSP3Header.description: Header block of a fixed-column satellite position container (SP3).

FILE_TYPE.description:
Record content indicator, e.g. "P" for positions only, "V" with
velocities.

SATELLITE_SYSTEM.description: Satellite system indicator recorded in the header.

ORBIT_TYPE.description: Orbit type as recorded, e.g. fitted, extrapolated, broadcast, helmert.

DATA_USED.description: Data used to produce the file, as recorded.

COORDINATE_SYSTEM.description: Terrestrial reference frame name as recorded.

AGENCY.description:
Producing agency as recorded IN THE FILE. This is observed content, not a
classification.

TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system as recorded in the header.

GPS_WEEK.description: Week number of the first epoch in the file's own week counter.

SECONDS_OF_WEEK.description: Seconds of week of the first epoch.

MODIFIED_JULIAN_DAY_START.description: Modified Julian Day of the first epoch.

FRACTIONAL_DAY.description: Fractional day of the first epoch.

NUMBER_OF_EPOCHS.description: Number of epochs declared in the header.

SATELLITE_ACCURACY_EXPONENTS.description:
Per-satellite accuracy exponents, parallel to SATELLITE_IDS. The accuracy
is POSITION_VELOCITY_BASE raised to this power.

POSITION_VELOCITY_BASE.description:
Base for the position and velocity standard-deviation exponents carried
per state in $OEM.

CLOCK_RATE_BASE.description: Base for the clock bias and clock rate standard-deviation exponents.

COMMENT.description: Header comment lines in file order.

NCDScenarioEpochContainer.description: Parameters of a scenario-epoch text container.

SCENARIO_EPOCH.description: Epoch that every record offset is measured from, ISO 8601.

TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time scale the scenario epoch is expressed in.

DISTANCE_UNIT.description: Distance unit of the records, e.g. "Meters", "Kilometers".

COORDINATE_SYSTEM.description: Named coordinate system of the records.

COORDINATE_AXES.description: Named coordinate axes, when stated separately from the system.

INTERPOLATION_SAMPLES_M1.description:
Interpolation order expressed as (samples - 1), which is how these
containers state it. Carried verbatim rather than converted, so a rewrite
reproduces the source exactly.

NUMBER_OF_EPHEMERIS_POINTS.description: Number of ephemeris points declared in the container.

SEGMENT_BOUNDARY_TIMES.description: Segment boundary offsets in seconds from SCENARIO_EPOCH, when present.

NCDCode500Header.description: Header words of a fixed-record binary ephemeris container.

SATELLITE_NAME.description: Object name as recorded in the header.

EPOCH_STEP_SECONDS.description: Uniform step between data records, seconds.

HEADER_WORDS.description:
The header record's packed words in file order, undecoded. A reader that
understands a word decodes it; a rewriter reproduces the record exactly
without having to.

NCD.description:
Native Container Descriptor.

The file-level facts of an ephemeris, attitude or tracking container that
are NOT properties of the messages inside it. $OEM, $AEM and $TDM carry the
states, attitudes and observations; none of them can carry the internal
file name, the comment area, the segment address ranges, the header accuracy
block or the interpolation order the source declared, because those describe
the CONTAINER. Without them a read-then-write cycle silently invents header
values, and a segmented binary file cannot be reproduced at all.

ONE record covers every container class rather than one record per format:
the file-level facts are the same kind of fact in each, and the
format-specific blocks are optional sub-tables selected by FORMAT. Only the
block matching FORMAT is populated.

PROVIDER_DEFINED_FORMAT_NAME.description: Format name when FORMAT is PROVIDER_DEFINED. Empty otherwise.

FORMAT_VERSION.description: Version of the container format as declared by the file itself.

PRODUCER.description: Producing system or organization as recorded IN THE FILE.

CREATION_DATE.description: Creation date recorded in the file, ISO 8601.

INTERNAL_FILE_NAME.description:
Container-internal file name, which is stored inside the file and is
independent of the name on disk.

COMMENT_AREA.description:
Free-text comment area carried inside the container, one entry per line,
in file order.

NATIVE_FRAME_NAME.description:
Reference frame name as the container itself spells it, before any
mapping onto $RFM.

NATIVE_FRAME_ID.description: Integer reference frame code as the container stores it.

NATIVE_TIME_SYSTEM.description:
Time system as the container itself spells it, before any mapping onto
the ratified time-scale vocabulary.

SEGMENTS.description:
Descriptors of the container's segments, in file order. Empty for a
single-span container.

SP3_HEADER.description: Header block when FORMAT is SP3_C or SP3_D.

SCENARIO_CONTAINER.description:
Parameters when FORMAT is SCENARIO_EPOCH_EPHEMERIS_TEXT or
SCENARIO_EPOCH_ATTITUDE_TEXT.

CODE_500_HEADER.description: Header words when FORMAT is CODE_500.

START_TIME.description: Total coverage start across all segments, ISO 8601.

STOP_TIME.description: Total coverage stop across all segments, ISO 8601.

SOURCE_BYTE_LENGTH.description: Length of the described container in bytes.

SOURCE_SHA256.description:
SHA-256 of the described container's exact bytes, lowercase hex. This is
what makes the descriptor checkable: a consumer can prove the descriptor
belongs to the file it holds.

SOURCE_CID.description:
Content identifier of the described container when it is addressed by
content rather than by path.

SELECT_START_TIME.description:
A reader's REQUEST, carried in the descriptor that frames the file so that
no option travels outside a typed record. Start of the inclusive window to
read, ISO 8601, on the container's own time scale. Default empty (from the
start of the container).

SELECT_STOP_TIME.description:
End of the inclusive window to read, ISO 8601, on the container's own time
scale. Default empty (to the end of the container).

SELECT_SAMPLE_INTERVAL_SECONDS.description: Thin the output to this spacing, seconds; 0 keeps every sample. Default 0.

SELECT_SATELLITE_SYSTEMS.description:
Satellite systems to read, as the RINEX letters G R E C J I S. Default
empty (every system the container holds).

SELECT_OBSERVATION_CODES.description: Observation codes to read (C1C, L1C, ...). Default empty (every code).

SELECT_CLOCK_ID.description:
Spacecraft clock id (for example -76) of a clock kernel to read; 0 selects
by the instrument id. Default 0.

MJD.description: Modified Julian Date in UTC, e.g., 58119

X_POLE_WANDER_RADIANS.description: x component of Pole Wander in radians, e.g., 2.872908911518888E-7

Y_POLE_WANDER_RADIANS.description: y component of Pole Wander in radians, e.g., 1.2003259523750447E-6

X_CELESTIAL_POLE_OFFSET_RADIANS.description: x component of Celestial Pole Offset in radians, e.g., 5.720801437092525E-10

Y_CELESTIAL_POLE_OFFSET_RADIANS.description: y component of Celestial Pole Offset in radians, e.g., -8.484239419416879E-10

UT1_MINUS_UTC_SECONDS.description: UT1 minus UTC in seconds, e.g., 0.2163567

TAI_MINUS_UTC_SECONDS.description: TAI minus UTC in seconds, e.g., 37

LENGTH_OF_DAY_CORRECTION_SECONDS.description: Correction to Length of Day in seconds, e.g., 8.094E-4

SERIES.description:
Published series this row was taken from. Rows from different series are
NOT interchangeable at the microarcsecond level and must not be merged
without recording which series each row came from.

IAU_CONVENTION.description:
Precession-nutation model the celestial pole offsets are expressed
against. X_/Y_CELESTIAL_POLE_OFFSET_RADIANS are CIP offsets in the GCRS
(dX, dY) under the IAU 2000/2006 conventions; a consumer cannot apply
them correctly without knowing which model produced them.

X_POLE_WANDER_UNCERTAINTY_RADIANS.description: 1-sigma uncertainty in x Pole Wander, radians.

Y_POLE_WANDER_UNCERTAINTY_RADIANS.description: 1-sigma uncertainty in y Pole Wander, radians.

X_CELESTIAL_POLE_OFFSET_UNCERTAINTY_RADI.description: 1-sigma uncertainty in the x Celestial Pole Offset, radians.

Y_CELESTIAL_POLE_OFFSET_UNCERTAINTY_RADI.description: 1-sigma uncertainty in the y Celestial Pole Offset, radians.

UT1_MINUS_UTC_UNCERTAINTY_SECONDS.description: 1-sigma uncertainty in UT1 minus UTC, seconds.

LENGTH_OF_DAY_UNCERTAINTY_SECONDS.description: 1-sigma uncertainty in the Length of Day correction, seconds.

X_POLE_WANDER_RADIANS_HP.description:
x component of Pole Wander in radians, double precision. Authoritative
over X_POLE_WANDER_RADIANS when present.

Y_POLE_WANDER_RADIANS_HP.description:
y component of Pole Wander in radians, double precision. Authoritative
over Y_POLE_WANDER_RADIANS when present.

X_CELESTIAL_POLE_OFFSET_RADIANS_HP.description:
x component of the Celestial Pole Offset in radians, double precision.
Authoritative over X_CELESTIAL_POLE_OFFSET_RADIANS when present.

Y_CELESTIAL_POLE_OFFSET_RADIANS_HP.description:
y component of the Celestial Pole Offset in radians, double precision.
Authoritative over Y_CELESTIAL_POLE_OFFSET_RADIANS when present.

UT1_MINUS_UTC_SECONDS_HP.description:
UT1 minus UTC in seconds, double precision. Authoritative over
UT1_MINUS_UTC_SECONDS when present.

LENGTH_OF_DAY_CORRECTION_SECONDS_HP.description:
Correction to Length of Day in seconds, double precision. Authoritative
over LENGTH_OF_DAY_CORRECTION_SECONDS when present.

DATA_SET_EPOCH.description:
Epoch of the data set this row was published in, ISO 8601 UTC. Identifies
WHICH issue of the series a consumer is holding; two rows for the same
MJD from different data-set epochs are different values, not duplicates.

DATA_SET_CID.description:
Content identifier of the complete published data set this row was taken
from. Every frames consumer that must agree bit-for-bit records this so
the source is provable rather than assumed.

NUTATION_DPSI_RADIANS.description:
Nutation correction in longitude (dPsi) against the IAU 1980 model,
radians, as published beside the CIP offsets by combined rapid-service
series.

NUTATION_DEPS_RADIANS.description:
Nutation correction in obliquity (dEps) against the IAU 1980 model,
radians.

PROVENANCE.description: Where this Earth-orientation row comes from and the terms it travels under.

KP1.description: Planetary 3-hour Range Index (Kp) for 0000-0300 UT, multiplied by 10

KP2.description: Planetary 3-hour Range Index (Kp) for 0300-0600 UT, multiplied by 10

KP3.description: Planetary 3-hour Range Index (Kp) for 0600-0900 UT, multiplied by 10

KP4.description: Planetary 3-hour Range Index (Kp) for 0900-1200 UT, multiplied by 10

KP5.description: Planetary 3-hour Range Index (Kp) for 1200-1500 UT, multiplied by 10

KP6.description: Planetary 3-hour Range Index (Kp) for 1500-1800 UT, multiplied by 10

KP7.description: Planetary 3-hour Range Index (Kp) for 1800-2100 UT, multiplied by 10

KP8.description: Planetary 3-hour Range Index (Kp) for 2100-0000 UT, multiplied by 10

KP_SUM.description: Sum of the 8 Kp indices for the day

AP_AVG.description: Arithmetic average of the 8 Ap indices for the day

PROVENANCE.description: Per-record source, provider, software, license terms and lineage.

PRWInit.description:
Propagator initialization request — assigns TLE / OMM / Keplerian /
polynomial inputs to entity handles.

The actual per-entity source record is carried inline as raw bytes
tagged with SOURCE_KIND and, where useful, a SDS file_identifier.
Callers encode `OMM`, `OCM`, or a one-off Keplerian set and pass the
bytes verbatim; the propagator uses SOURCE_KIND to decide how to
consume them.

ENTITY_HANDLES.description: Entity handles to assign results to (same order as SOURCES[]).

SOURCES.description: Per-entity source records, encoded as SDS FlatBuffers.

MU.description: Gravitational parameter of the central body (km^3 / s^2).

RAAN.description: Right ascension of the ascending node (radians).

NORAD_ID.description: NORAD catalog number parsed from the TLE.

BYTES.description: Encoded source record as a FlatBuffer (consumed per KIND).

KEPLERIAN.description: Convenience inline form when KIND == KEPLERIAN.

TLE.description: Convenience inline form when KIND == TLE.

PRWBatchRequest.description:
Batch propagation request — propagate every entity in ENTITY_HANDLES[] to
EPOCH and write the result StateVector stream to OUTPUT_OFFSET in the
shared arena.

EPOCH.description: Target epoch as a Julian date (TIME_SYSTEM is configured on the host).

ENTITY_HANDLES.description: Entity handles to propagate (empty = all initialized entities).

OUTPUT_OFFSET.description: Output buffer offset in the arena where the StateVector stream begins.

MAX_COUNT.description: Maximum entities to process in this call (0 = unbounded).

TARGET_FRAME.description:
Target reference frame for the output state stream. Matches enum
values in SDS `RFM`. If zero, the propagator chooses its native frame.

PRWBatchResponse.description:
Batch propagation response header — describes the stream written to
OUTPUT_OFFSET and reports errors. The stream itself is
`STATE_VECTOR_SIZE`-tuple rows in the SDS `OCM` STATE_DATA layout.

OUTPUT_OFFSET.description: Offset in the arena where the state-vector stream begins.

STATE_VECTOR_SIZE.description: Components per state vector (6 = PV, 9 = PVA). Mirrors OCM.STATE_VECTOR_SIZE.

REFERENCE_FRAME.description: Reference frame for the stream (SDS `RFM`-compatible string tag).

FLAGS.description: Per-entity status flags (same cardinality as COUNT).

ERROR_MESSAGE.description: Optional error message when ERROR_CODE != OK.

PRWInstance.description: Instance identity is host-provided, opaque, and not a physical quantity.

GENERATION.description: Incremented on reinitialization or configuration invalidation.

PRWStateMatrix.description:
Row-major square matrix on [x,y,z,vx,vy,vz,(mass)], then the execution
request's DYNAMIC_PARAMETERS in order, SI units (prwDynamicParameter).
Covariance entries have row*column units; STM entries row/column units;
an STM's parameter rows are the identity (parameters are constant).

PRWProcessNoise.description: The process noise a propagated covariance includes: P(t) = Phi P0 Phi^T + Q.

SPECTRAL_DENSITY_M2_S3.description: Acceleration power spectral density per axis (x, y, z or R, T, N), m^2/s^3.

DISCRETIZATION_SECONDS.description: Interval over which each noise increment enters, seconds.

PRWResidentState.description: Identity/state at one epoch. FRM state is m/m/s with named frame/time scale.

MASS_KG.description: Optional initial dynamical mass in kg; distinct from a missing mass.

HAS_MASS_KG.description: True when MASS_KG carries a value; false means absent.

DRAG_AREA_OVER_MASS_M2_KG.description:
Explicit SI concepts Cd*A/m and Cr*A/m. Do not infer these from legacy
ignored/underspecified coefficients; require a caller-provided mapping.

HAS_DRAG_AREA_OVER_MASS_M2_KG.description: True when DRAG_AREA_OVER_MASS_M2_KG carries a value; false means absent.

HAS_SRP_AREA_OVER_MASS_M2_KG.description: True when SRP_AREA_OVER_MASS_M2_KG carries a value; false means absent.

PROCESS_NOISE.description:
Process noise for COVARIANCE: on input, what propagation adds; on
output, what the propagated COVARIANCE includes. Absent means none.

DRAG_AREA_OVER_MASS_RATE_M2_KG_S.description:
Rate of change of DRAG_AREA_OVER_MASS_M2_KG, m2/kg/s, from STATE's epoch
(the BDOT of a VCM).

HAS_DRAG_AREA_OVER_MASS_RATE_M2_KG_S.description: True when DRAG_AREA_OVER_MASS_RATE_M2_KG_S carries a value; false means absent.

IN_TRACK_ACCELERATION_M_S2.description: Constant in-track acceleration, m/s2, as PCFForceModel's.

HAS_IN_TRACK_ACCELERATION_M_S2.description: True when IN_TRACK_ACCELERATION_M_S2 carries a value; false means absent.

PRWImpulse.description: Impulsive change at TDB epoch; delta velocity is m/s in the named basis.

PRWThrottlePoint.description: Piecewise-linear throttle. Clock is seconds from initial propagation epoch.

PRWBurnBoundary.description: Scheduled time gates an optional condition. At least one must be present.

HAS_ELAPSED_SECONDS.description: True when ELAPSED_SECONDS carries a value; false means absent.

CONDITION.description: SI PCE predicate; direction and goal tolerance explicitly populated.

PRWFiniteBurn.description:
Finite thrust. RTN=(rhat, N cross rhat, N), N=unit(r cross v).
VNC=(vhat, unit(r cross v), vhat cross unit(r cross v)).

HAS_FORCE_NEWTONS.description: True when FORCE_NEWTONS carries a value; false means absent.

HAS_ACCELERATION_M_S2.description: True when ACCELERATION_M_S2 carries a value; false means absent.

DIRECTION.description: Dimensionless components; normalized after adding elapsed*time rate.

DIRECTION_RATE.description: Direction-component change per second, not radians/second.

KIND.description: The event function that crossed zero.

DIRECTION.description: The way g crossed zero: INCREASING or DECREASING.

ELAPSED_SECONDS.description: Seconds from the request's initial epoch, negative for a backward propagation.

STATE.description: The state at EPOCH in the request's axes.

PRWExecutionRequest.description: Fixed endpoint propagation. Provider selected by the host's connected port.

INCLUDE_MASS_DYNAMICS.description: Explicitly selects 7-state integration even if FINITE_BURNS is empty.

PROCESS_NOISE.description: Process noise added to the propagated covariance. Absent means none.

DYNAMIC_PARAMETERS.description:
Model parameters appended, in this order and without repeats, to
INITIAL_COVARIANCE and to every sample's STM and COVARIANCE, so a
covariance carries their uncertainty and correlation (a VCM's 7x7 to
10x10). Each must be active in FORCES. Empty means the state alone.

EVENTS.description:
Events located inside the integration (PCFEventDefinition, shared with $PCF).
They apply to a plain state propagation (no STM, covariance, samples, impulses
or burns) by an integrator with a continuous extension; any other request that
names events is refused. Default empty.

PRWBurnReport.description: Burn times absent until reached; zero means an actual edge at initial epoch.

HAS_START_SECONDS.description: True when START_SECONDS carries a value; false means absent.

HAS_STOP_SECONDS.description: True when STOP_SECONDS carries a value; false means absent.

DELTA_V_M_S.description: Integral of thrust acceleration magnitude, m/s; not vector net delta-v.

STM.description: Both STMs cumulative from request initial epoch; SI state units.

PROCESS_NOISE.description: The process noise COVARIANCE includes. Absent means none.

DYNAMIC_PARAMETERS.description: The parameters the samples' STM and COVARIANCE carry after the state.

EVENTS.description: The located events with ACTION RECORD or STOP, in time order of propagation.

EVENT_OCCURRENCES.description: Per request EVENTS entry, the qualifying crossings the propagation passed.

STOPPED_BY_EVENT.description: Index of the request EVENTS entry that ended the propagation, or -1. Default -1.

PRWResidentRequest.description: Portable batch request: no output pointer; state records returned via TAB.

PRWPrepareRequest.description: All epochs explicit; duration seconds >=0; empty handles means all resident.

PROFILE.description: Provider-advertised profile name; unrecognized nonempty values fail.

MAXIMUM_POSITION_ERROR_M.description: SI metres and metres/second; absent when UNMEASURED.

HAS_MAXIMUM_POSITION_ERROR_M.description: True when MAXIMUM_POSITION_ERROR_M carries a value; false means absent.

HAS_MAXIMUM_VELOCITY_ERROR_M_S.description: True when MAXIMUM_VELOCITY_ERROR_M_S carries a value; false means absent.

PRWTrajectorySource.description: Existing PPE retains km/km/s, midpoint/time-system and coefficient meaning.

SEGMENT_QUALITY.description: One quality record per PPE.POSITION_RECORDS entry, same order.

SOURCE_OFFSET.description: Chunking indexes SOURCES; no partial polynomial coefficient vector.

PRWNativeInput.description: Native container bytes wholly inside the FlatBuffer; not an NCD trailer.

CONTENT.description: Exactly DESCRIPTOR.SOURCE_BYTE_LENGTH bytes; verify declared hash.

PRWEarthOrientation.description:
Earth orientation for a propagation: one instantaneous row, or daily rows
of one series (same SERIES, IAU_CONVENTION and data-set provenance) with
strictly increasing MJD that cover the arc. A provider interpolates as
published by the series and does not extrapolate.

PRWSpaceWeatherTable.description:
Daily space weather for a propagation, as published (`SPW`), with strictly
increasing DATE covering the arc plus what the atmosphere model reads
before it (NRLMSISE-00 reads the previous day's F10.7). A provider derives
its model inputs from these rows and reports which ones it reads.

PRWJB2008Indices.description:
One UTC day of JB2008 drivers, as Space Environment Technologies publishes
them (SOLFSMY.TXT and DTCFILE.TXT): solar indices in SFU with their
